questions.question: How many freight rail carloads were moved in the United States during March 2019?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('dot_bts_monthly_transportation_statistics.csv')
df['Date_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
row = df[(df['Date_dt'].dt.year == 2019) & (df['Date_dt'].dt.month == 3)].iloc[0]
result = int(row['Freight Rail Carloads'])

questions.question: In which month did seasonally adjusted transit ridership across other transit modes reach its all-time high?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('dot_bts_monthly_transportation_statistics.csv')
df['Date_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
peak_row = df.loc[df['Transit Ridership - Other Transit Modes - Adjusted'].idxmax()]
result = peak_row['Date_dt'].strftime('%Y-%m')

questions.question: In August 2018, was the total value of U.S. transborder freight with Mexico higher than that with Canada?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('dot_bts_monthly_transportation_statistics.csv')
df['Date_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
row = df[(df['Date_dt'].dt.year == 2018) & (df['Date_dt'].dt.month == 8)].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if row['Transborder - U.S. - Mexico Freight'] > row['Transborder - U.S. - Canada Freight'] else 'no'

questions.question: In March 2019, by how much did freight rail intermodal units exceed freight rail carloads?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('dot_bts_monthly_transportation_statistics.csv')
df['Date_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
row = df[(df['Date_dt'].dt.year == 2019) & (df['Date_dt'].dt.month == 3)].iloc[0]
diff = row['Freight Rail Intermodal Units'] - row['Freight Rail Carloads']
result = int(diff)
